tools.name: lookup_policy
tools.description: Look up a US retailer's published return, price adjustment, warranty, or cancellation policy with quoted source text and a TRACE receipt. Call before Black Friday / Cyber Week purchase decisions (holiday_extended_return.policy_year overlays, price_adjustment_detail honesty). Call Dec 26–Jan 31 for r

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Fetch a public receipt from a prior Deadline Desk policy lookup. ddr_ IDs return a format v1 receipt (signed, software-only TRACE record); older dd- IDs return the v0 log entry.
